title: Tour Guide briefing (Contract C18 wave 2: the written briefing per day)
description: The words a brochure day is read by, written for one build of a plan: per date the lead, key-time tiles, the glance-page row, food on the route, if-then lines, the bail-out, why this plan, and the day kit. brochure-map merges it per date into the kit's day with options.briefing (only together with options.c18). Contract C18 wave 3: `book: "day"` marks a briefing written for a Day book (one date; food and if-then up to 10; `inside`, the order inside a big stop). Every object refuses unknown keys; the caps are the brochure kit's (kits/brochure/lib/model.mjs BRIEF_CAPS: the schema holds the largest, the checks the book's own). schemas/index.mjs also checks: every date key a calendar date, key times in time order, a weather low not above its high, and per book: a brochure briefing at most 6 food and 6 if-then and no inside; a Day book briefing exactly one date and inside times in order.

book.description: Contract C18 wave 3: the book the briefing was written for — brochure (the default) or day (the Day book of one date).

build_id.description: The plan build the briefing was written for; brochure-map ignores a briefing whose build_id is not the plan's.

theme.description: Replaces the plan's theme as the day's headline.

lead.description: The answer first; replaces the summary line under the title.

contents.description: The day's row on the glance page.

food.description: At most 6 in a brochure briefing, 10 in a Day book's (checked per book).

if_then.description: At most 6 in a brochure briefing, 10 in a Day book's (checked per book).

inside.description: Day book only: per stop (the stop's place slug) the order inside it, up to 10 steps, each with an optional time.

place.description: A place of the plan; the name links to its card when the brochure has one.
